name: A Righteous Cause

angles.text: Garek Bandarion and Danitha's cohort represent an extraordinary development: Forsaken rediscovering how to wield the Holy Light as paladins despite their undead state.
While Leonid and Danitha strive to reconnect with the Light, most of the Forsaken remain distant or hostile to the holy path in their unlife.
Leonid Barthalomew's presence highlights ties between Undercity's defenders and the Argent Dawn based at Light's Hope Chapel in the Plaguelands.

faq.answer: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered is a prominent undead member of the Argent Dawn. Though he operates out of Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, he maintains ties with former comrades in Lordaeron who fought alongside him against the Scourge.
faq.q: Who is Leonid Barthalomew the Revered?

faq.answer: Danitha Morr is a Forsaken leader who fought alongside Leonid Barthalomew during the Scourge attack on the Undercity. She now leads a cohort dedicated to carrying forward the teachings and holy legacy of Garek Bandarion.

Garek Bandarion was a heroic Forsaken fighter who fell during the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. Leonid notes he may have been the very first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Holy Light as a paladin.

When the necropolis Naxxramas launched an assault against the Undercity, Forsaken champions including Danitha Morr, Leonid Barthalomew, and Garek Bandarion banded together to defend the city against the Scourge onslaught, suffering heavy losses in the struggle.
faq.q: What happened during the attack on the Undercity?

faq.answer: While channeling the Light causes excruciating pain to undead flesh and is rejected by most of the Forsaken, Garek Bandarion demonstrated that it is possible for an undead warrior to wield the Holy Light as a paladin, a practice Danitha and her cohort continue to study.
faq.q: Can the Forsaken wield the Light as paladins?

faq.answer: After visiting his friends and speaking with Danitha Morr, Leonid plans to return to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, where the Argent Dawn coordinates their crusade against the Scourge.
faq.q: Where does Leonid Barthalomew go after this?

sections.body: A Righteous Cause centers on a poignant reunion between two veteran defenders of Lordaeron: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered and Danitha Morr. Having survived the harrowing assault when Naxxramas unleashed the Scourge upon the Undercity, the two reflect upon their fallen comrades and the difficult path walked by Forsaken who still revere the Holy Light.
sections.title: Reunion of Veterans

sections.body: The focal point of their shared memory is Garek Bandarion, the fallen hero after whom the keep was named. According to Leonid, Garek may have been the very first of the Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Holy Light as a true paladin. While most Forsaken have turned away from the Light entirely, Danitha and her cohort dedicate themselves to preserving Garek's legacy and exploring the potential of holy unlife.
sections.title: The Legacy of Garek Bandarion

sections.body: Following his discussion with Danitha, Leonid prepares to depart the keep. His loyalties lie with the ongoing fight against the Scourge in the ravaged east, where he makes his station at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, welcoming any able-bodied adventurers willing to take up arms for the cause.
sections.title: Return to the Plaguelands

summary: A Righteous Cause witnesses a conversation between Leonid Barthalomew the Revered and Danitha Morr as they reflect on the defense of the Undercity against Naxxramas. Their exchange highlights the memory of Garek Bandarion, an undead hero who rediscovered how to wield the Holy Light as a paladin. The quest illuminates the rare Forsaken who strive to maintain their connection to the Light despite the skepticism of their kin.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Righteous Cause
